hs.syntax:
visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9

poldem.syntax:
# measurement model
ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
dem60 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4
dem65 =~ y5 + y6 + y7 + y8
# regressions
dem60 ~ ind60
dem65 ~ ind60 + dem60
# residual correlations
y1 ~~ y5
y2 ~~ y4 + y6
y3 ~~ y7
y4 ~~ y8
y6 ~~ y8

mediation.syntax:
X =~ x1 + x2 + x3
M =~ m1 + m2 + m3
Y =~ y1 + y2 + y3
M ~ a*X
Y ~ c*X + b*M
ind := a*b
